name: hcportal_savePermissionMatrix
description: Saves one grantor's row of the Permissions V2 matrix. GLOBAL scope (@publicKennelId NULL): replaces the grantor's global HC.RolePermission rows (KennelId NULL) with Allowed = 1 rows for @functionKeys. KENNEL scope (@publicKennelId set): replaces the grantor's rows for that kennel with +1 rows for @grantedKeys and -1 rows for @revokedKeys; functions in neither list inherit the global default. Either way HC6.nonApi_compilePermissionMatrix recompiles the JSON projections in the same transaction (the compile-on-save invariant). Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth; service accounts refused; caller must hold a live HC.PlatformAdmin row with CanManagePermissions = 1.

parameters.name: grantorKey
parameters.description: The grantor (HC.PermissionRole.GrantorKey) being edited. Unknown or a 'bypass' grantor is refused.

parameters.name: functionKeys
parameters.description: GLOBAL scope: '|'-delimited granted FunctionKey list. Empty = grantor grants nothing.

parameters.name: publicKennelId
parameters.description: When set, edits that kennel's tri-state override instead of the global default. Unknown kennel is refused.

parameters.name: revokedKeys
parameters.description: KENNEL scope: '|'-delimited force-revoke (-1) FunctionKey list. Functions in neither list inherit global.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Always one row. Success = 0 on auth failure, service-account caller, missing CanManagePermissions, unknown/non-editable grantor, unknown kennel, or from the CATCH block (ROLLBACK, HC.ErrorLog row, ERROR_MESSAGE()).

sideEffects: DELETE + INSERT HC.RolePermission for the grantor in the chosen scope (global: Allowed 1 rows; kennel: +1 / -1 rows)
EXEC HC6.nonApi_compilePermissionMatrix @kennelId = scope — recompiles HC.ServerStatus.PermissionMatrixJson and the per-kennel HC.Kennel.PermissionOverrideJson, bumps the watermark
On a runtime error: INSERT HC.ErrorLog after the ROLLBACK

codeSmells.detail: Lines 84-86, 95-97, 100-102 JOIN the split keys to HC.PermissionFunction; a misspelt or retired key is ignored rather than reported, and a key listed in both @grantedKeys and @revokedKeys gets two rows (+1 and -1).

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
